tools.name: similar_sites
tools.description: Find related listed publishers by vector similarity to a known domain. Returns compact profiles, cosine similarity and actual shared section keys. Similarity is not affiliation, endorsement or proof of equivalent capabilities. Uses stored vectors without a paid call per request; unavailable or stale

tools.name: list_sections
tools.description: Discover publisher section labels across the indexed corpus, distinct-site counts, newly observed labels, conservative emerging signals and seven-day membership changes. Emerging requires ten estimated domain-name families, excludes known templates/duplicates and waits three days; this measures inde

tools.name: explore_sections
tools.description: Explore relationships between publisher headings. Edges count distinct listed sites sharing both labels. Pass section keys to return related labels and a bounded page of publishers; no sections returns aggregate clusters only. Discovery is monitored without automatic usage quotas.

tools.name: resolve
tools.description: Start here to find documentation for a domain or development task. Returns specific page URLs with publisher excerpts, matching evidence, owner-stated terms, freshness and alternatives. A named publisher stays scoped to its valid documentation or known replacement. No usable publisher or insufficien

tools.name: directory_stats
tools.description: Directory-wide counts for Agent Web Map: domains tracked, valid llms.txt files, listed, verified, pending.

tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: List country codes and names with valid listed-site counts, plus the unknown count. Use country=FR or country=unknown with resolve, search_llms_registry, list_domains, list_sections and explore_sections. Owner-declared or site-published addresses are preferred; domain/hosting inference is a labeled

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List topic taxonomy and counts by inferred category and agentic label, unclassified sites and publisher-declared MCP endpoints. Categories describe topics; capabilities are separate explicit publisher declarations. Counts can overlap. Use category or capability filters with resolve, search_llms_regi

tools.name: search_llms_registry
tools.description: Search domains and indexed documentation links by words and meaning. Relevance ranks before authority and ownership verification, with keyword fallback if semantic search is unavailable. Compact results omit owner claims by default; use detail=full for profile metadata.

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: Ranked listing of the directory (verified first, then authority). Use verified_only to get only owner-verified sites.

tools.name: lookup_domain
tools.description: Look up a domain: source URLs, summary, authority, ownership verification, inferred country, last check and owner-stated terms. Compact by default; detail=full adds profile, nested files, badge and ownership claim instructions.

tools.name: read_llms_txt
tools.description: Return our validated copy of a listed site's llms.txt as text, with its source URL, check date and content hash. No second fetch needed, and it works when the publisher blocks automated clients. A site not cached yet is fetched once on demand.

tools.name: verification_instructions
tools.description: Describe optional ownership management and its four proof methods. Call begin_ownership_claim to obtain a fresh expiring proof and a private claim secret. No ownership claim is needed for discovery.

tools.name: check_llms_txt
tools.description: Validate a site's llms.txt: reachability, HTML-instead-of-text, redirects to other domains, H1 title, summary, sections, links, link health, llms-full.txt and charset. Returns each check with what to fix and the file preview. Ownership management is optional and does not affect validation.

tools.name: generate_llms_txt
tools.description: Draft an llms.txt for a site from its own homepage, sitemap and page titles. Takes 10-30 seconds. The owner reviews it and publishes it at /llms.txt. Ownership management is optional and uses a separate fresh challenge.

tools.name: register_domain
tools.description: Submit a public domain or announce a file update to queue a live crawl, including previously invalid tracked domains. Same-domain requests are coalesced with a ten-minute cooldown. Existing listings stay visible until checked; queueing does not guarantee listing or prove ownership. Returns reason an

tools.name: begin_ownership_claim
tools.description: Start optional ownership management or recovery for a domain you control. Returns an expiring fresh public proof token and a private claim_secret shown once. Keep the secret private; publish only the verification snippet, then call verify_domain with claim_id and claim_secret. Existing keys remain v

tools.name: verify_domain
tools.description: Complete the fresh challenge from begin_ownership_claim using its private claim credentials. Checks the published proof and consumes the challenge once, returning the owner API key shown once. Public or legacy proof tokens alone cannot issue keys. Recovery replaces previous credentials and sessions.

tools.name: rotate_owner_key
tools.description: Owner only. Replace the API key and invalidate all existing browser owner sessions. Keep the new key; it is shown once. Does not require changing the existing ownership proof.

tools.name: update_site
tools.description: Verified owner only. Control the listing profile (description, tags, nested llms.txt paths, contact, owner-declared publisher_country) and terms for agents (agent_terms: automated_access = one of welcome | limited | ask | not_allowed: may agents use the site automatically?; rate_limit = short text,

tools.name: site_stats
tools.description: Verified owner only. Review measured website, REST and MCP requests, daily activity, documentation selections, publisher clicks, file health and the last 30 score snapshots. Counts include bots, tests and repeated requests; they do not identify unique agents or confirm publisher page reads.

tools.name: recrawl_site
tools.description: Verified owner only. Re-validate and update the directory listing now (once per 10 minutes). This crawl can change listing and ownership verification state. Review the result and return to the owner dashboard for activity and history.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: resolve, lookup_domain, read_llms_txt, check_llms_txt, register_domain, recrawl_site · Private data: directory_stats, lookup_domain, verification_instructions, check_llms_txt, register_domain, begin_ownership_claim, verify_domain, rotate_owner_key, update_site, site_stats · Public sink: register_domain, begin_ownership_claim.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: resolve, lookup_domain, read_llms_txt, check_llms_txt, register_domain, recrawl_site · Private data: directory_stats, lookup_domain, verification_instructions, check_llms_txt, register_domain, begin_ownership_claim, verify_domain, rotate_owner_key, update_site, site_stats · Public sink: register_domain, begin_ownership_claim

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
